# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- Prefer auth UX: if user previously logged in with a real account, show an initial 'Tap to enter' screen with buttons (Account/Policy/Version etc.), allow logout/switch account; guest users should not see this extra screen.
- Before acting, always read the project's README/bible first (user will provide it as reference). If compilation fails, assume Unity/VS may need an update/restart; continue working without removing the change just to make it compile immediately.

## Game Layout
- Place pickups and scopes near the respective player's hand, on their right side.
